target.title: fix(session-memory): bound session transcript reads to prevent OOM
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`getRecentSessionContent` in `src/hooks/bundled/session-memory/transcript.ts` reads session transcript JSONL files with an unbounded `fs.promises.readFile` call. A runaway or corrupted session file could force the session-memory extraction path to buffer the entire file into memory, leading to OOM.

## Why This Change Was Made

Session transcripts are line-oriented JSONL files. A 16 MiB cap is generous headroom for long sessions while preventing the memory-extraction path from being used as a memory exhaustion vector. When the cap is exceeded the function returns `null`, which is the existing failure fallback.

## User Impact

Session-memory extraction now safely skips oversized transcripts instead of risking process OOM.

## Evidence

- Added a regression test that writes a transcript exceeding the 16 MiB cap and asserts `getRecentSessionContent` returns `null`.
- Local focused run: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/hooks/bundled/session-memory/transcript.test.ts --run` passes (4/4 tests).
